items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: Well, at the time, I was with the Sharky group... we were in a dream room... And then we went out on tour... I really enjoyed my year with Sharky

ctx.x: You can meet some real problems. Well, anyhow, there's a lot of bands that we talked about and we'd mentioned the leader. But for example, we never did talk about really who was in Sharky's band and too much of what you did with him.

Well, at the time, I was with the Sharky group. Sharky had called me like five months in advance and he said, Bob, would you like to make a road tour with me? I said, well, sure. But I said, when are you planning on leaving? And he said, oh, I'm about six months from now. I said, well, Sharky, why don't you call me about two months in advance? And then I could more officially give you an answer. You know, I mean, I don't like to plan anything six months in advance. That's pretty far away. So he says, okay. So he…
Did you say who the clarinet player was? Oh, uh... Start at the top. The high note.
